name: A Case of Stolen Candy
author: Grandma Hsu
queryHints:
We should first find the total
amount of items each suspect
has taken.

We can find this by applying a
GROUP BY on the names and items taken
of each trick-or-treater.

We can use the COUNT function
to find the number of items
each trick-or-treater has taken.

We should then find the total
amount of items they can take
based on the households they've
been to, and compare the results!
caseHints:
It seems like you can only take
one of each type of item offered
by each household!
